arabic text: SAR TAN SE JUDA HOTE HI, ZAINAB YEH PUKAARI\nQUR'AN BHALA HUMSE, JUDA KAUN KAREGA
english translation text: AS SOON AS THE BLESSED HEAD WAS SEVERED FROM THE BLESSED BODY, ZAINAB CRIED OUT\nWHO COULD EVER SEPARATE THE QUR'AN FROM US

arabic text: SADIYON SE ISI SOCH MEIN GHUM KARB-O-BALA THI\nHUN KHAAK, MUJHE KHAAK-E-SHIFA KAUN KAREGA
english translation text: FOR CENTURIES, KARB-O-BALA WAS ABSORBED IN THIS GRIEF\nI AM MERE DUST; WHO WILL MAKE ME KHAAK-E-SHIFA

arabic text: DARKAAR HAI MAZLOOM ASEERON KO RIHAAYI\nYEH KAAM SAKINA KE SIWA KAUN KAREGA
english translation text: THE WRONGED CAPTIVES AWAIT THEIR FREEDOM\nWHO BUT SAKINA WILL ACCOMPLISH THIS WORK

arabic text: HAM JAATE HAIN ZINDAAN SE, AY BAALI SAKINA\nROSHAN TERI TURBAT PE, DIYA KAUN KAREGA
english translation text: WE ARE LEAVING THE PRISON, O LITTLE SAKINA\nWHO WILL LIGHT A LAMP AT YOUR GRAVE

arabic text: BHAIYON KE MAZAARAAT PE, BIBI NE KAHA THA\nAB HAMSE ULAJNE KI, KHATAA KAUN KAREGA
english translation text: AT HER BROTHERS' GRAVES, BIBI HAD SAID\nWHO WILL NOW ERR BY STANDING AGAINST US

arabic text: YEH KHUTBA-E-ZAINAB KI, SADAA BOL RAHI HAI\nHAI KAUN SITAMGAAR, JAFAA KAUN KAREGA
english translation text: THE VOICE OF ZAINAB'S SERMON STILL PROCLAIMS\nWHAT OPPRESSOR REMAINS; WHO WILL DARE COMMIT TYRANNY
